mapper.sql: select c.comment_id, c.user_id, c.target_type, c.target_id, c.content, c.del_flag, c.create_time, c.update_time, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = c.user_id) as user_name from learning_comment c
mapper.select: where c.target_type = #{targetType} and c.target_id = #{targetId} and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.comment_id desc
select count(*) from learning_comment where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into learning_comment (user_id, target_type, target_id, content, del_flag, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{content}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.update: update learning_comment set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where comment_id = #{commentId} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_post where post_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from learning_course where course_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from learning_short_video where video_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
